name: SolarpunkSurvival
engine: Unreal Engine 5 (IoStore; exe stamped UE5-CL-0, exact minor TBD via UE4SS dump)
ue4ssVersion: Solarpunk-patched UE4SS (SP Developer 1.0.3), bundled as a trimmed runtime-only payload in vendor/ — stock UE4SS cannot scan UE 5.7.1
notes: Install with `python install.py` (see docs/INSTALL.md) — everything is bundled, nothing to download. The content pak carries the wands, the Tempest Codex and its research cards; without it the Lua mod still runs, minus those items.
